description: Scrape public YouTube comments and reply threads without login, user cookies, or an API key. Provide one or more videos, channels, playlists, or search queries.

channelUrls.description: Channel /videos sources: /@handle, /channel/UC..., /c/name, /user/name, a bare @handle, or a UC... channel ID. Scrapes up to Max videos per source.
channelUrls.title: Channel URLs or handles

commentsSince.description: Optional cutoff as an ISO date/datetime (2026-10-16) or relative duration (7d, 24h, 30m). Forces newest sort. Pinned comments are always kept; pagination stops at the first non-pinned comment older than the cutoff.
commentsSince.title: Comments since

emitStatusRows.description: Write one recordType=status row for blocked, private, unavailable, comments-off, empty-token, invalid-input, partial and budget-stop cases. Status rows are never counted toward Max total rows; disable this to keep the dataset data-only.
emitStatusRows.title: Emit status rows

includeReplies.description: Fetch reply threads. Emitted as flat rows by default; use Output mode tree to embed them instead.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

keywords.description: Case-insensitive OR filter on comment and reply text. Empty = no keyword filter. A parent comment that does not match is skipped, so its replies are not fetched.
keywords.title: Keywords (ANY match)

maxComments.description: Top-level comments to examine per video. 0 = all. Comments rejected by filters still count toward this scan cap (so restrictive filters cannot paginate forever); replies do not. Both emitted comments and replies count toward Max total rows.
maxComments.title: Max top-level comments per video

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Per-thread reply cap. 0 = all replies, stopping when the continuation token is exhausted. YouTube serves roughly 9-10 on the first reply page and 44-49 afterwards.
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max replies per comment

maxReplyDepth.description: 0 = top-level comments only, 1 = direct replies (the shape observed publicly). Values above 1 are reserved for nested sub-threads, which YouTube has not exposed in the samples used to build this actor.
maxReplyDepth.title: Max reply depth

maxTotalRows.description: Global budget for emitted comment + reply rows. 0 = unlimited. Status rows are never counted and are not billable data rows.
maxTotalRows.title: Max total rows

maxVideosPerSource.description: Discovery cap for channel, playlist and search sources. 0 = every video the source exposes.
maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per channel/playlist/search

minLikes.description: Drop comments and replies below this like count. Applied after fetching. YouTube only exposes rounded counts (K/M), so the comparison uses the rounded value.
minLikes.title: Minimum likes

onlyCreatorHearted.description: Keep only comments/replies that the video creator hearted. HeartedBy identifies the creator where YouTube exposes the tooltip.
onlyCreatorHearted.title: Only creator-hearted comments

outputMode.description: flat = one row per comment and reply (recommended for CSV/Excel/SQL); tree = parent rows with embedded replies[] (backward compatible); both = flat rows plus parent rows carrying replies[].
outputMode.title: Output mode

playlistUrls.description: Playlist sources: youtube.com/playlist?list=... or a bare playlist ID. Scrapes up to Max videos per source.
playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs or IDs

searchQueries.description: YouTube search terms or search-result URLs. Only video results are used, deduplicated, up to Max videos per source.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: top = YouTube relevance order; newest = chronological, recommended for date cutoffs and complete windows. A date cutoff forces newest automatically.
sortBy.title: Sort comments by

videoUrls.description: Watch, youtu.be, Shorts, embed, live, v/ links, or bare 11-character IDs. Every video is normalized to a watch URL internally.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs or IDs

title: YouTube Comments & Reply Thread Scraper Input
